praecōnor , āri,
I.v. dep. n. [praeco], to perform the office of public crier or herald, to herald, proclaim; to praise (post-class.), Interpr. Iren. 5: “fama praeconans,” Mart. Cap. 1, § 63 ; Arn. in Psa. 92 and 97.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
